name: sail-lsp
description: Language support for Sail with navigation, diagnostics, hover, inlay hints, and bundled sail-lsp binaries

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension can analyze Sail files in restricted mode, but launching the bundled server still executes a local binary.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The bundled sail-lsp server expects real filesystem access for indexing and $include resolution.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node ./out/src/test/runTest.js

semanticTokenTypes.description: Style for builtin types such as `bits` and `unit`
Style for escapes such as `\n` in string literals

semanticTokenModifiers.description: Style for `var` bindings at every mention, and for a register where it is written

sail-lsp.workspace.linkedProjects.markdownDescription: Explicit projects, relative to each workspace root or absolute. Entries can override variables and root modules. Replaces automatic discovery when nonempty.

sail-lsp.workspace.activeProject.markdownDescription: Preferred manifest for analysis of files shared by multiple projects. Other projects remain loaded and checked separately.

sail-lsp.flycheck.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Maximum time for one compiler check before terminating it.

sail-lsp.flycheck.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Coalesce consecutive saves before starting a compiler check.

sail-lsp.formatting.lineWidth.markdownDescription: Soft line width for Sail formatting. Existing multiline layouts and aligned instruction tables are preserved.

sail-lsp.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `sail-lsp` binary. If not set, the extension looks for `sail-lsp` in `$PATH` or the bundled server.

sail-lsp.server.extraEnv.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables passed to the `sail-lsp` process. Example: `{ "SAIL_DIR": "/path/to/sail" }`.

sail-lsp.trace.server.markdownDescription: Traces the communication between VS Code and the sail-lsp server.
enumDescriptions: Log the messages exchanged with the server.
Log the messages with their full contents.

sail-lsp.diagnostics.enable.markdownDescription: Enable diagnostics (parse errors, type errors, etc.).

sail-lsp.diagnostics.effectMismatch.markdownDescription: Report effect diagnostics: an impure call in a pure function (effect-violation), effect-mismatch and missing-effect-annotation.

sail-lsp.diagnostics.disabled.markdownDescription: List of diagnostic codes to disable (e.g., "unused-variable").

sail-lsp.diagnostics.warningsAsHint.markdownDescription: Diagnostic codes to show as hints instead of warnings.

sail-lsp.diagnostics.warningsAsInfo.markdownDescription: Diagnostic codes to show as info instead of warnings.

sail-lsp.inlayHints.typeHints.markdownDescription: Show type hints for let bindings.

sail-lsp.inlayHints.parameterHints.markdownDescription: Show parameter name hints in function calls.

sail-lsp.inlayHints.chainingHints.markdownDescription: Show intermediate types in field-access chains.

sail-lsp.inlayHints.enumValueHints.markdownDescription: Show numeric enum values when Sail generates an enum-to-number conversion.

sail-lsp.inlayHints.implicitArgumentHint.markdownDescription: Show the inferred value of an `implicit('n)` argument at the call site, e.g. `widen(8, x)`.

sail-lsp.inlayHints.effectHints.markdownDescription: Show effect annotations on function calls.

sail-lsp.inlayHints.maxLength.markdownDescription: Maximum length of inlay hints before truncation.

sail-lsp.inlayHints.closingBraceHintsMin.markdownDescription: Minimum lines for closing brace hints to appear.

sail-lsp.completion.addCallParenthesis.markdownDescription: Add parentheses when completing function calls.

sail-lsp.completion.limit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of completion items returned.

sail-lsp.completion.fullFunctionSignatur.markdownDescription: Show full function signatures in completions.

sail-lsp.codeLens.references.markdownDescription: Show reference counts as code lenses.

sail-lsp.codeLens.implementations.markdownDescription: Show implementation counts as code lenses.

sail-lsp.hover.maxFieldsCount.markdownDescription: Maximum struct or union members in hover; null shows all.

sail-lsp.hover.maxEnumVariantsCount.markdownDescription: Maximum enum variants in hover; null shows all.

sail-lsp.hover.maxOverloadsCount.markdownDescription: Maximum overload alternatives in hover; null shows all.

sail-lsp.signatureInfo.detail.markdownDescription: How much of a callable's signature the signature help shows.

sail-lsp.signatureInfo.documentation.markdownDescription: Show the callable's documentation in signature help.

sail-lsp.semanticTokens.strings.markdownDescription: Use semantic tokens for string literals and the escapes inside them.

sail-lsp.semanticTokens.punctuation.markdownDescription: Use semantic tokens for punctuation: brackets, commas, semicolons.

sail-lsp.semanticTokens.nonStandardToken.markdownDescription: Send the server's own token types and modifiers (`register`, `builtinType`, `mutable`, ...). When off, each is replaced by the standard type it refines, or dropped.

sail-lsp.workspace.projectFile.markdownDescription: Project manifest path, relative to each workspace folder or absolute. Auto-detection prefers root `sail.proj`, then a single root `*.sail_project`; otherwise checks immediate child directories for a unique project (excluding hidden directories). Files outside a loaded project receive syntax diagnostics and an unlinked-file warning.

sail-lsp.workspace.projectVariables.markdownDescription: Override variables in the Sail project manifest (for example `RMEM: true`).

sail-lsp.workspace.projectModules.markdownDescription: Root modules to load with the modules they transitively require (a child requires its parent; a parent does not bring its children), as `sail `--project` P A` does. Empty selects all modules.

sail-lsp.workspace.generatedFiles.markdownDescription: Map manifest `__virtual` filenames to generated Sail files. Paths are absolute or relative to the workspace root. The producer owns the contents.

sail-lsp.workspace.strictBitvector.markdownDescription: Match Sail's `--strict-bitvector` mode: vector lengths must be natural numbers.

sail-lsp.workspace.primeCachesNumThreads.markdownDescription: Threads used to pre-warm caches after loading. 0 uses half of the machine's cores.

sail-lsp.flycheck.enable.markdownDescription: Run the upstream Sail compiler on save and after project/configuration reload. Projects use their manifest, variables and selected roots; standalone files are checked individually.

sail-lsp.flycheck.command.markdownDescription: The Sail compiler binary flycheck runs.

sail-lsp.flycheck.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments passed to the Sail compiler (for example `--config` or `--strict-bitvector`).

sail-lsp.cache.parseCapacity.markdownDescription: Retained raw and semantic parse query results. 0 disables this family’s LRU.

sail-lsp.cache.environmentCapacity.markdownDescription: Retained per-file type environment query results. 0 disables this family’s LRU.

sail-lsp.cache.inferenceCapacity.markdownDescription: Retained results per inference query (body, adapter and file diagnostics). 0 disables this family’s LRU.

sail-lsp.cache.bodyCapacity.markdownDescription: Retained results per callable body/source-map query. 0 disables this family’s LRU.

sail-lsp.cache.memoryLimitMb.markdownDescription: Soft process RSS high-water mark in MiB. Above it, idle cache collection reduces query capacities; 0 disables automatic pressure control. Inputs and live snapshots can prevent reaching this target.

sail-lsp.runnables.showCodeLens.markdownDescription: Show loaded-project check, test and export tasks above Sail documents, and a run lens above every `$[test]` function and `main`.

sail-lsp.testExplorer.markdownDescription: List the `$[test]` functions of open Sail files in the Test Explorer and run them in the Sail interpreter (`sail <project arguments> --is <script>`). Upstream Sail has no test runner: a test passes when the interpreter evaluates it to `Result = ()` without printing `Error:`.

sail-lsp.restartServerOnConfigChange.markdownDescription: Restart the server automatically when a setting that only takes effect at start changes (`sail-lsp.server.path`, `sail-lsp.server.extraEnv`, `sail-lsp.trace.server`), instead of asking.

sail-lsp.runnables.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout in milliseconds for project tasks run through standard LSP source actions. Native VS Code tasks use the task terminal and are cancelled separately.

project.description: Manifest path relative to the workspace root, or absolute. Omit to expose the task for every loaded project.

sail-lsp.runnables.tasks.markdownDescription: Explicit project test/export tasks. Commands run as processes in the manifest directory. Pass `${projectArgs}` as a whole argument, or `${projectContext}` in an argument/environment value. Other placeholders: `${sail}`, `${project}`, `${projectDir}`, `${workspaceRoot}`.

sail-lsp.completion.customTemplates.markdownDescription: Custom prefix/postfix templates using LSP snippet syntax. Postfix bodies may use `${receiver}`.

sail-lsp.completion.termSearch.markdownDescription: Suggest type-directed expressions composed from visible callables and local values. Search is bounded and does not invoke SMT.

sail-lsp.completion.termSearchFuel.markdownDescription: Maximum work units for type-directed completion; zero disables search. Maximum composition depth is three calls.

sail-lsp.flycheck.diagnosticFormat.markdownDescription: Compiler output format: auto negotiates editor diagnostic protocol v1 and falls back to terminal text; json requires protocol v1; text disables probing.
enumDescriptions: Negotiate editor diagnostic protocol v1 and fall back to terminal text.
Editor diagnostic protocol v1; fails on a compiler without it.

sail-lsp.flycheck.cache.markdownDescription: Manage a persistent compiler memo cache per project and toolchain, use Sail defaults, or disable memoization. Explicit memo flags in extraArgs take precedence.
enumDescriptions: A persistent compiler memo cache per project and toolchain, managed by the server.

sail-lsp.flycheck.cacheDirectory.markdownDescription: Managed compiler cache root. Null uses the OS user cache directory; relative paths use the compiler working directory.

sail-lsp.flycheck.ignore.markdownDescription: Compiler diagnostic codes to hide. Also accepts * and severity:error/warning/information/hint. Presentation does not change compiler success.

sail-lsp.flycheck.warningsAsHint.markdownDescription: Compiler diagnostic codes or severity selectors to display as hints. Native diagnostics and compiler success are unchanged.

sail-lsp.flycheck.warningsAsInfo.markdownDescription: Compiler diagnostic codes or severity selectors to display as information. Native diagnostics and compiler success are unchanged.

command.description: The program to run, usually the Sail compiler.

args.description: Arguments passed to the program as given; no shell interprets them.

cwd.description: Working directory; the workspace folder when omitted.

env.description: Environment variables set for the program.

script.description: Contents of a Sail interpreter script. It is stored in a file whose path is appended to the arguments, so end them with `--is`.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Sail
walkthroughs.description: Open a Sail project, read the status bar, and find the commands.

steps.title: Install the server
steps.description:
The extension starts the bundled `sail-lsp`, a managed installation (`sail-lsp install --editor vscode`), or the binary named by `sail-lsp.server.path`.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22sail-lsp.server%22%5D)

steps.title: Open a project
steps.description:
A folder with a `sail.proj` or a single `*.sail_project` manifest is loaded on its own; set `sail-lsp.workspace.projectFile` to pick one, or `linkedProjects` for several. A `.sail` file outside every project gets an unlinked-file warning with a fix that adds it.
[Open the manifest](command:sail-lsp.openProjectManifest)

steps.title: Read the status bar
steps.description:
The **Sail** item shows whether the server is loading, ready, or failed; hover for the last message, click for the full status report.
[Show status](command:sail-lsp.analyzerStatus)

steps.title: Find the commands
steps.description:
Everything is under the **Sail** category of the Command Palette: project tasks and tests, structural search, module dependencies, the syntax tree and HIR views.
[Run a project task](command:sail-lsp.runProjectTask)
